description:
All order-1 internal-control cells sit after all order-2 target cells in the pinned campaign grid, and the driver returns at its first non-terminal cell, so no control can be measured until the most expensive target cell reaches a terminal state.

## Background

The campaign driver processes cells in grid order and stops the invocation at the first cell that ends interrupted. The highest-SNR order-2 cell is orders of magnitude more expensive than any order-1 cell, so the cheap control series is unmeasurable until the most expensive measurement completes. Controls lose their diagnostic value when they cannot run early.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: An invocation continues to later cells after recording an interrupted cell, or the pinned grid orders cells so controls precede the open-ended target cells; either way controls are measurable while a target cell is still open.
- [hard] REQ-02: Checkpoint resume semantics and per-cell determinism are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: The pinned eBCH grid still records the same cell identities and seeds for completed cells.
title: pinned grid blocks internal-control cells behind the hardest target cell
